reviews.text:
Here’s a natural, concise review you could use:

The Beplain Cleansing Oil is one of the best cleansing oils I’ve tried. It easily removes sunscreen, makeup, and daily impurities without leaving an oily residue. The texture is lightweight, emulsifies well with water, and rinses off cleanly.

After cleansing, my skin feels soft, clean, and hydrated instead of dry or tight. It doesn’t irritate my skin or clog my pores, making it a great option for daily use. Overall, it’s a gentle and effective cleansing oil that I’d happily repurchase.
reviews.zh:
以下係一個自然簡潔嘅評價：

beplain 卸妝油係我用過嘅最好嘅卸妝油之一。輕鬆卸走防曬、化妝同日常污垢，唔會剩低油膩感。質地輕盈，搽水後乳化得好，洗完都好清爽。

用完之後皮膚感覺柔軟、乾淨、保濕，而唔係乾燥或者繃緊。佢唔會刺激皮膚或者塞毛孔，適合每日使用。整體嚟講係一支溫和又有效嘅卸妝油，我會好樂意回購。

reviews.text: This cleansing oil cleans pores and gets makeup off easily. You have to use quite a bit in order to avoid tugging on your skin, but other than that I've been very happy with it. I plan on buying the big one next.
reviews.zh: 呢支卸妝油可以清潔毛孔同輕鬆卸走化妝。要用多啲先唔會扯住皮膚，但除此之外我好滿意。打算下次買大支裝。

reviews.text: Liked this cute little bottle. I'm actually not used to using cleansing oil. I bought this just to remove my mascara because, you know, removing Korean mascaras requires effort
reviews.zh: 鍾意呢支得意嘅細支裝。其實我唔係好慣用卸妝油。買佢只係為咗卸睫毛液，你都知啦，韓國嘅睫毛液真係好難卸。

reviews.text: It’s my first experience with double cleansing. During the process, I could actually see dead skin rolling off. After using the oil and cleanser, the result is immediately visible — smooth, clean skin.
reviews.zh: 係我第一次體驗double cleansing。過程中可以清楚見到死皮成條捲出嚟。用完卸妝油同潔膚產品之後，效果即時可見——皮膚又滑又乾淨。

reviews.text: I had never tried a emulsifying cleansing oil, definitely a new experience for me. That being said I don't believe this particular one removes makeup or gets rid of build up as advertised.
reviews.zh: 我從未試過乳化型嘅卸妝油，對我嚟講真係新體驗。雖然係咁，我唔覺得呢一支真係做到佢聲稱嘅卸妝或者清除積累污垢嘅效果。

reviews.text: I tried this oil today and really liked it. It cleanses well and doesn’t leave a greasy feeling on the skin. I bought the small size to see how my skin reacts.
reviews.zh: 今日試咗呢支卸妝油，好鍾意。清潔力好而且用完皮膚唔會有油膩感。買咗細支裝先睇下皮膚反應。

reviews.text: I don’t like the texture it’s too liquid, I’m used to manyo cleansing oil. I don’t feel like my skin is rly clean after using it, since I started using it ( 2 weeks ago ) my jaw has become a bit grainy again.
reviews.zh: 我唔鍾意個質地，太水。我用開 manyo 卸妝油。用完之後唔覺得皮膚真係乾淨，自從兩星期前開始用，下巴位又變得有啲粗糙。

reviews.text: It’s very gentle and light on my skin I was happy they have the small size so I can try it before I buy the big bottle. I use it to cleanse the sunscreen from my face, and I use the regular cleanser from pen lain as a double cleansing.
reviews.zh: 對我皮膚好溫和、好輕盈，好開心佢哋有細支裝，可以喺買大支之前先試吓。我用佢嚟卸走塊面嘅防曬，再用 pen lain 嘅常規潔面產品做雙重清潔。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
